title: InputPartitionSelection
description: A coverage-scope rule within a CoverageRequirement that names exactly one InputSpacePartition and declares which of its PartitionValues must be exercised. The rule takes one of two forms: an explicit include list, or all values minus an exclude list. It selects equivalence classes and never binds concrete test data. Use InputSelection instead when a single partition value is bound to a concrete test datum for one specific TestCaseSketch, rather than a set of classes being declared in scope for a requirement. Use PartitionValue instead when you are defining the equivalence class itself (its label, constraint and representative value), not choosing which classes to cover. Use PartitionDependency instead when the inclusion or exclusion of values in one field is conditional on a value chosen in another field. Use CoverageRequirement instead when you are stating the overall criterion (pairwise, boundary-values, MC/DC) and priority, rather than the per-partition value subset it draws on.

partitionRef.description: ID of the testing.inputspacepartition from which values are being selected for coverage.

coverValues.description: Comma-separated labels or IDs of specific partition values to include in coverage. Ignored when coverAllCategories is true.

coverAllCategories.description: When true, all partition values are included in coverage except those listed in excludeValues. Overrides coverValues.

excludeValues.description: Comma-separated labels or IDs of partition values to exclude from coverage. Applied when coverAllCategories is true to carve out specific values.

x-dr-standard: IEEE 829-2008 Level Test Design Specification (Clause 10), approach refinements: selection of equivalence classes to be exercised
x-dr-evidence: A combinatorial test model file (e.g. a PICT .txt or ACTS model) that lists one parameter with only a subset of its defined value classes.
A test-design YAML/JSON block keyed by an input field or partition name, with include/exclude lists or an 'all: true, except: [...]' form.
A parametrized test (pytest.mark.parametrize, it.each, @EnumSource(mode = EXCLUDE)) iterating over one field's enum or equivalence classes, with specific classes deliberately omitted or excluded.
